author.displayName: Rafał Wiktorowicz and Braun SI Wiktorowicz (NovaraX)

summary: Rafał Wiktorowicz and Braun SI adapt Michael Devine's public Apache-2.0 eight-detector formalisation (85.6399404234%) in Yuanda Xu's distinct-zero counting framework, on Kristian Muri Knausgård's Lean foundations. We reoptimise the affine dual multipliers and rebuild the four rational PSD repairs, lowering the repair cost about tenfold. The distinct-zero transfer also appears in our v15 Zenodo record. Warm thanks to all three.
method: Eight-detector certificate with reoptimized dual multipliers, four rational PSD repairs and the signed multiplicity bound.
